relative_position: variable.u.x * ((variable.particle_random_1 * variable.r) * math.cos((variable.rot + variable.spin * variable.particle_age)) - ((variable.particle_random_2 - 0.5) * variable.w) * math.sin((variable.rot + variable.spin * variable.particle_age))) + variable.v.x * ((variable.particle_random_1 * variable.r) * math.sin((variable.rot + variable.spin * variable.particle_age)) + ((variable.particle_random_2 - 0.5) * variable.w) * math.cos((variable.rot + variable.spin * variable.particle_age)))

variable.u.y * ((variable.particle_random_1 * variable.r) * math.cos((variable.rot + variable.spin * variable.particle_age)) - ((variable.particle_random_2 - 0.5) * variable.w) * math.sin((variable.rot + variable.spin * variable.particle_age))) + variable.v.y * ((variable.particle_random_1 * variable.r) * math.sin((variable.rot + variable.spin * variable.particle_age)) + ((variable.particle_random_2 - 0.5) * variable.w) * math.cos((variable.rot + variable.spin * variable.particle_age)))

variable.u.z * ((variable.particle_random_1 * variable.r) * math.cos((variable.rot + variable.spin * variable.particle_age)) - ((variable.particle_random_2 - 0.5) * variable.w) * math.sin((variable.rot + variable.spin * variable.particle_age))) + variable.v.z * ((variable.particle_random_1 * variable.r) * math.sin((variable.rot + variable.spin * variable.particle_age)) + ((variable.particle_random_2 - 0.5) * variable.w) * math.cos((variable.rot + variable.spin * variable.particle_age)))

color: variable.a * math.clamp((variable.life - variable.particle_age) / math.max(0.05, variable.fade), 0, 1) * math.clamp((variable.particle_age - variable.draw * (variable.particle_random_1)) / 0.12, 0, 1)
